## RestServer.route() method

Register a new generic route.

**Signature:**

```typescript
route(route: RouteEntry): Binding;
```

## Example


```ts
function greet(name: string) {
 return `hello ${name}`;
}
const route = new Route('get', '/', operationSpec, greet);
```
